svg.title: TetraGate gateway - board layout
svg.text: Illustration of the bench build - not to scale
USB: power, SWD and the console UART
Each radio is an independent SPI bus (SPI1-SPI4) with its own NSS, RST and DIO0 line, so one failed module cannot stall the other three.
The TFT is on SPI5, the touch controller on SPI6, the EEPROM on I2C1 and the PC console on USART3 through the ST-LINK virtual COM port.
